_comment: Single consolidated OSF registration update for osf.io/ab2wn, filed at arXiv posting: supersedes the unfiled update3 and update4 drafts (amendments 9-12a, one deviation, two corrections, the human correctness audit, the release).
376-12: Searching, screening, system grouping, coding and synthesis are complete and the dataset is released. The search was frozen on 2026-09-16 (50,724 raw records, 27,747 candidates after deduplication). Title/abstract screening closed 2026-09-18 and full-text screening 2026-09-20: 9,967 records sought at full text, 8,435 assessed, 7,085 included, grouped into 6,504 systems under the corrected grouping of amendment 10. Coding closed 2026-09-23 under the revised absence rule of amendment 9; after the release was rebuilt on 2026-09-25 the released coded set is 1,256 systems on all 38 dimensions (47,728 cells), schema frozen as v1.0. HARNESS-DB v1.0.0 was released on 2026-09-25 (https://github.com/harness-db/harness-db; Zenodo concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23031354, version 1.0.0 10.5281/zenodo.23031355). A human correctness audit of 350 coded cells was run on 2026-09-28/29. The controlled ablation of amendments 12 and 12a stopped at its pilot, which failed its pre-stated accuracy band; no confirmatory run was made. The preprint is about to be posted on arXiv, and this registration's embargo will be ended early at posting.
376-94: Stage 1: pilot, systems coded twice independently by two model readings; the pilot was run on 217 systems rather than the registered 30, because the 20% reliability sample was available and a larger pilot costs only compute. Stage 2: per-dimension kappa between the two readings; dimensions below 0.6 are redefined or dropped; schema frozen as v1 with a changelog. Stage 3: coding of the stratified coded set (amendments 6 and 10) in two passes: pass A reads the whole evidence bundle and returns all 38 dimensions with a verbatim quote and a locator per cell; pass B re-reads only the cells pass A left unresolved, invalid or without a verbatim quote. A deterministic 20% sample is coded a second time, independently, and both codings go through the repair pass. Stage 4: outcomes extraction from papers and leaderboards. Stage 5 (added 2026-09-28): a human correctness audit of 350 cells. Each cell is in one of three states: a value with evidence, not_reported (the sources were read and are silent, a finding), or unresolved (the coder could not settle it and claims nothing). The release gate as implemented admits a system with at least 19 of 38 dimensions settled, valued or not_reported, with no layer condition. That is not registered criterion 4.7, which counts only values with evidence and needs one in each of layers A, B and C; it is recorded as a deviation without amendment, discovered 2026-09-28: 613 of the 1,256 released systems value fewer than 19 dimensions and 664 would fail the registered test. The stricter rule stated in update 2, all 38 cells settled, would admit 77 of the 1,257 systems coded and discard the roughly 31 cells a typical system does settle.
376-96: The coding manual (docs/coding_manual.md, frozen as v1.0) gives decision rules per dimension and two worked examples (SWE-agent, OpenHands). Rules: code the pinned version; repository beats paper when they disagree; every claimed value carries verbatim evidence; multi-valued dimensions take every applicable value. Amendment 9 rewrote the rule that separates an absence from silence, because the registered manual contradicted itself on it: an absence value is coded only when the evidence contains the place where the feature would be declared if it existed and the feature is not there, citing that place; otherwise the cell is `not_reported` and the note names the place that was missing. The absence of a mention in prose is never evidence of absence.
376-102: Cohen's kappa per dimension on the double-coded sample (247 systems, 20% of the coded set), computed between two independent readings that have both been through the repair pass, and reported in the manuscript and with the dataset. Because both readings are model readings (amendment 4), these figures measure the reproducibility of the coding procedure, not agreement with a human coder, and are reported with that meaning stated. Result: observed agreement 0.870, mean per-dimension kappa 0.784 (Gwet's AC1 0.855), and 37 of 38 dimensions at or above 0.6. Two further statistics are reported beside kappa, neither replacing it: Gwet's AC1, because Cohen's kappa collapses when one category dominates and would otherwise condemn dimensions the readings agree on almost everywhere; and, for multi-valued dimensions, the mean per-value kappa, because exact-set matching scores two readings as a total mismatch whenever one lists an extra value. Per-value kappa is not substituted where it flatters - it is lower than the exact-set figure for `retry_policy` (0.491 against 0.671) and `edit_primitive` (0.589 against 0.648) - and every figure is published per dimension in data/coded/reliability_final.json.
376-106: Evidence-per-cell coding makes every value auditable. Amendment 4 changes who does the verifying: no human verifies every cell, because 1,256 systems at 38 dimensions is 47,728 cells. Every claimed value carries a quote checked mechanically, character for character, against the exact text the coder was given; cells that fail, or fall outside their dimension's permitted values, are re-read in a repair pass. Nothing is coerced: a cell the repair pass cannot settle is published as unresolved. The rates of unresolved and non-verbatim cells are reported as data-quality figures. HUMAN CORRECTNESS AUDIT (protocol, seed and sample fixed 2026-09-28; read 2026-09-28/29): 50 weight-bearing systems outside the double-coded sample (H 10, P 10, O 30) on seven dimensions, the five with the highest weighted silence rate and two design dimensions, 350 cells. The model reading matches the human reading exactly on 202 of 350 cells (57.7%, paper-clustered bootstrap 95% interval [48.6, 66.9]; 61.8% weighted to the frame), against 0.870 agreement between two model readings: reproducibility does not carry over to correctness. Of 148 disagreements, 117 are evidence-bundle gaps, where the passage the human cited was not in the text the model was sent (113-119 as the matching threshold varies); on cells whose evidence the model received it is correct on 202 of 233 (86.7%). The adjudication was mechanical, not case by case, a second deviation from the audit protocol; the accuracy figure is computed before it and is unchanged by it.
376-108: HARNESS-DB v1.0.0 was released on 2026-09-25 as CSV and JSON with a JSON Schema, validator and continuous integration, publicly on GitHub (https://github.com/harness-db/harness-db) and archived on Zenodo (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23031354; version 1.0.0: 10.5281/zenodo.23031355), under CC BY 4.0; a Hugging Face mirror is pending. Each coded cell carries its value, its evidence, a confidence, and the flag distinguishing not_reported from unresolved; the per-cell audit table adds the quote, the locator, the verbatim-check result and every validation flag, so a reader can re-derive any published value. Two superseded artifacts are published alongside, clearly marked, because each is the evidence for an amendment: the coding produced under the pre-amendment-9 absence rule, and the PRISMA counts computed before the grouping correction of amendment 10. The human-audit sheet, sample and results, and the controlled-ablation pilot data of amendments 12 and 12a, are to be published in the same repository with the preprint.
376-116: not_reported is a first-class value: its rate per dimension is a result (RQ4), reported unweighted and weighted to the census, since strata P and O are sampled and less visible systems document less. Cells marked not_reported are excluded pairwise from association analyses; no imputation. Cells marked unresolved (the coder could not settle them, 0.3% of released cells) are excluded from the under-reporting rate, because counting an admission as a finding would inflate it. On the 1,256-system release 48.9% of cells are not_reported (23,337 of 47,728), against 26.9% under the ambiguous absence rule amendment 9 replaced. Weighted by layer the rate runs from 24.9% +/- 1.2 (control loop) to 81.6% +/- 1.8 (sandbox and environment); the highest dimensions are network_policy 93.4%, replayability 90.6%, filesystem_access 87.5% and rollback 86.4%. CORRECTION (2026-09-25): layer standard errors now take the system, not the cell, as the sampling unit, because a system's cells are correlated; rates and per-dimension errors are unchanged, layer errors move (sandbox 1.2 to 1.8) and the largest is 2.3 points, not 2.0. CONSEQUENCE OF THE HUMAN AUDIT (2026-09-28/29): the model coded from an evidence bundle capped at 110,000 characters while the human readers searched the full pinned repository, and on the five audited silence dimensions the humans confirmed only 41-63% of the model's not_reported cells. Every silence rate is therefore an upper bound on silence in the pinned sources: it measures the evidence bundle, not the repository.
376-48: Include if all of: (a) the source describes a system that wraps an LLM in a loop with tools or an environment; (b) the system's first public release is between 2022-10-01 and 2026-08-31; (c) the paper or documentation is available in English. Exclude: training or reinforcement-learning-only work with no harness description (recorded in a side table where it changes the harness); embodied robotics; benchmarks with no reference harness (recorded for the outcomes table only); single-prompt systems without a loop; components that implement one clause without the loop (sandboxes, tool or protocol specifications, skills packs, tracing SDKs); frameworks with no shipped default agent; duplicate descriptions of one system (the canonical description is kept and the rest are linked). Amendment 5: the registered codability requirement (at least 19 of 38 dimensions assigned a value with evidence, with one in each of layers A, B and C) is no longer applied at screening. Judging it from a paper alone excluded 11 of 15 reference systems, including ReAct, CodeAct, AutoGen, MetaGPT, Reflexion and OS-Copilot, all codable from their repositories; the test was moved to coding, and the estimate recorded at screening is reported but not decisive. DEVIATION, NO AMENDMENT (discovered 2026-09-28): the gate as implemented at coding is not the registered test. It counts a dimension when it is settled, valued or not_reported, and has no layer condition. Of the 1,256 released systems, 613 value fewer than 19 dimensions and 664 would fail the registered test on either clause; none settles fewer than 19. The registered definition is left as written and the deviation is reported in the manuscript.
376-82: Screening is a census of all records returned by the frozen search plus snowballing, with no sampling: the 7,085 included records group into 6,504 systems under the corrected grouping of amendment 10, far more than the 150-300 expected at registration. Coding is therefore stratified rather than exhaustive (amendment 6), with known rates so that census-level proportions remain estimable. Stratum H (a repository with 500 or more stars at freeze, or catalogued by a prior harness survey, or a vendor or major-lab product) holds 984 systems, coded completely (weight 1); stratum P (not in H but described in a peer-reviewed paper with a public implementation) holds 683, of which a random 150 are coded (weight 4.5533); stratum O (the remainder) holds 4,837, of which a random 100 are coded (weight 48.37): 1,234 systems drawn. The released coded set is 1,256 systems: 1,233 of the 1,234 drawn (one, 'con', is coded but its reserved file name blocked the release build) plus 23 systems coded outside the draw, several of them benchmark reference agents the recall check required, which carry weight 0 because their inclusion probability is not the design one. Field-level estimates are weighted over the 1,233 drawn systems (weights sum to 6,503); coded-set statements are unweighted over 1,256. The sampling seed and the per-system assignment are published with the dataset. Codability is deliberately not a stratum criterion: requiring the codability flag recorded at screening would have dropped 11 of the 27 reference systems.
376-100: Coders are not masked to system identity (impossible when reading source code). The reliability subset is selected by a published deterministic rule and coded a second time in a separate call that cannot see the first reading's values. In the human correctness audit (2026-09-28/29) the readers worked from a sheet showing each system's pinned version, repository and papers and the coding manual's value lists and decision rules, and never the model's values, states, evidence or notes. The audit protocol called for an independent coder blind to the project; the 350 cells were instead read by the author together with colleagues and recorded under one coder identifier, so the readers were blind to the model's answers but not to the project. This is a deviation from the audit protocol and is disclosed in the manuscript.
376-122: 1. Descriptive statistics per dimension and per year: weighted to the census with design standard errors (system as the sampling unit), and unweighted over the coded set with Wilson intervals. 2. Pairwise association between design dimensions (bias-corrected Cramer's V) and hierarchical clustering into design families, which must pass quality bars stated before clustering. 3. Convergence over time: entropy of each dimension's value distribution by release year. 4. RQ3, AMENDMENT 11 (2026-09-24): the registered mixed-effects regression of score on design variables with benchmark-by-model fixed effects is not identifiable and is not fitted (53 systems share a benchmark-split-model key with another coded system: 36 keys against 38 design dimensions). In its place: the comparable set published in full; scores standardised within key; five contrasts, each with a bootstrap over keys, a within-key permutation test that governs where the two disagree, its design floor and a minimum detectable effect, nulls reported as findings. The contrasts were specified after the comparable set was assembled, so they are post hoc. Multi-agent topology is +0.88 within-key sd [+0.38, +1.31] over 18 keys on the rebuilt 1,256-system release, an association, superseding +1.01 over 17 keys on the previous release. 5. Under-reporting by dimension and layer (RQ4), as registered. 6. The registered optional validation (five systems re-run through an existing harness benchmark) is replaced by AMENDMENTS 12 and 12a: a compute-matched controlled ablation of self-verification; it stopped at its pilot, which failed the pre-stated 25-70% accuracy band, and no confirmatory run was made. 7. Added: within-paper ablation contrasts harvested from the included papers and pooled by random effects, with a null-fill sensitivity; CORRECTION (2026-09-28): the cap on added nulls was lifted, having left self-verification undiscounted: pooled +0.152 relative, discounted +0.076.
376-134: Registered sensitivity analyses (a) to (c) were re-fits of the registered mixed-effects regression (excluding self-reported scores; excluding systems with more than 30% not_reported cells; excluding each benchmark in turn) and lapse with it, because that regression is not fitted (amendment 11). Registered analysis (d), with and without model-pre-filled cells that a human coder changed, lapses with amendment 4, because no human coder revises cells; the human correctness audit takes its place. In their place: for the five within-key contrasts, a within-key permutation test beside the key-level bootstrap (the permutation test governs where they disagree), the permutation design floor, and the minimum detectable effect at 80% power; for pooled within-paper ablation contrasts, a null-fill sensitivity that adds null contrasts and reports the discounted estimate (self-verification: pooled +0.152, discounted +0.076, 528 nulls to halve it; the cap on added nulls was lifted on 2026-09-28 because it had left this dimension undiscounted); and, for the under-reporting rates, the human correctness audit (2026-09-28/29), which shows them to be upper bounds.
_justification:
This single update brings the registration up to date at preprint posting. Amendments 1-8 are on the record (updates of 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-20). It files amendment 9 and the completion of coding, then amendments 10-12a, one deviation, two corrections, a human correctness audit and the release. Amendment 9 was logged in the protocol before the dataset was re-coded under it but, like the rest, is filed on OSF only now.

AMENDMENT 9 (2026-09-23). ABSENCE IS NOT SILENCE. Two general rules in the coding manual contradicted each other on the commonest judgement in coding. Rule 2 told a coder who cannot point at evidence to record `not_reported`; rule 5 told them to code an absence as a value (`none`, `open`) citing the place where the feature would be registered if it existed. A coder who searches for a rollback mechanism and finds nothing satisfies both rules, and the two independent readings of the double-coded sample split on exactly that: their notes agreed on the evidence ("no replay facility found") while one recorded a value and the other recorded silence. That single ambiguity put 19 of 38 dimensions below the 0.6 reliability threshold - `rollback` on 0.97 of its disagreements, `replayability` 0.96, `network_policy` 0.94. Rule 5 is rewritten as an ordered test: if the evidence contains the place where the feature would be declared (config schema, CLI flags, tool or plugin registry, the run loop, a documented feature list) and the feature is not there, code the absence value and cite that place at confidence at most medium; if the evidence contains no such place, code `not_reported` and name the missing place. The absence of a mention in prose is never evidence of absence, and `not_reported` is never correct once the declaring place has been opened. The change was validated before the dataset was rebuilt rather than assumed: the same 217 systems were coded twice under the revised rule, which moved observed agreement from 0.597 to 0.872 and Cohen's kappa from 0.564 to 0.832 on that validation set (pass A only on both sides, as recorded at the time), and the whole coded set was then re-coded under prompt `code-v2-2026-09-23`. These validation figures are a before/after on one set of systems and are not the released reliability figures, which are reported separately on the 247-system double-coded sample with both sides repaired. The superseded coding is kept at data/coded/v1_rule5_ambiguous/ as the evidence for the change. THE CORRECTION RAISES THE HEADLINE RATE: the share of cells recorded `not_reported` rises from 26.9% to 48.9%, because prose that never mentions a feature was previously being read as evidence that the feature is absent. RQ4 is therefore larger and better founded than registered. CELL STATES. A third state, `unresolved`, is added beside `not_reported` for cells the coder could not settle, so that an admission is never counted as a finding; 0.3% of released cells (163) are unresolved. CODING COMPLETE AND SCHEMA FROZEN (2026-09-23). After the release was rebuilt under amendment 10 on 2026-09-25, 1,256 systems are released (47,728 cells: 50.8% coded with evidence, 48.9% not_reported, 0.3% unresolved), schema v1.0 is frozen with all 38 dimensions intact - none added, removed, renamed or re-valued - and 37 of 38 dimensions clear the registered kappa >= 0.6 freeze condition. `loop_primitives` is 0.590 on exact-set match and is kept and flagged rather than redefined, because it is multi-valued and exact-set matching scores two readings as a total mismatch whenever one lists an extra primitive, while per value the readings agree on 93% of present/absent decisions (per-value kappa 0.731, Gwet's AC1 0.628). Two systems (`cai`, `pentagi`) are coded by a different model because the primary model's safety classifier stops mid-response on offensive-security agents; this is recorded per row and affects 0.2% of the set.

It also files protocol amendments 10, 11, 12 and 12a, one deviation without amendment, two corrections that change reported numbers, a human correctness audit, and the dataset release. TIMING, STATED PLAINLY: none of these was filed on OSF before the analysis it describes. Amendments 10 and 11 were logged in the protocol on 2026-09-24 and applied the same day; amendment 11's contrasts were specified after the comparable set was assembled. Amendments 12 and 12a were frozen in the repository before any confirmatory instance was scored, but not filed before the pilots they describe, and 12a was written in response to pilot results; amendment 12's frozen text calls itself filed, which it was not until now. The audit protocol was fixed on 2026-09-28 and the audit run on 2026-09-28/29, before this filing. Manuscript drafts describing amendments 10-12a as filed or accepted were premature; this update is their filing.

2026-09-24, AMENDMENT 10 (grouping). Transitive fuzzy name matching pooled 129 records carrying 105 distinct names into one system row. Name similarity no longer merges records with different known repositories, and without a repository the normalised names must be equal. The census becomes 6,504 systems (the protocol log recorded 6,501 from a first repair pass; a second pass that day restored Agent S3, Agent S2 and AgentK as rows, removing nothing); reference-set recall stays 27/27; the coded set is redrawn at 1,234 (H 984 complete, 150 of 683 in P, 100 of 4,837 in O).

2026-09-24, AMENDMENT 11 (RQ3; post hoc, not pre-stage). The registered mixed-effects regression is not identifiable (53 systems share a comparable key: 36 keys against 38 design dimensions) and is not fitted. Five within-key contrasts replace it, specified after the comparable set was assembled. The entry's result, multi-agent topology +1.01 [+0.53, +1.37] over 17 keys, came from the previous release and is superseded by +0.88 [+0.38, +1.31] over 18 keys on the rebuilt 1,256-system release.

2026-09-24, AMENDMENT 12 (controlled ablation, as frozen). H2: at equal compute, extra calls spent on verify-and-repair beat the same calls spent on unguided retries. Three arms, one codebase, model, temperature and scorer: A, one attempt; B, attempt plus self-written checks and repair, up to k = 4 calls; C, exactly B's call count on the same instance as unguided attempts. Primary: paired B-C difference in the per-instance fraction of hidden checks passed (bootstrap over instances, permutation test, MDE always reported). Suite chosen on a disjoint pilot pool by arm-A accuracy in a 25-70% band; if none is in band the experiment is reported as failed and the band is not re-tuned. Seeds (at least 3) and the instance count (80% power at +7 points) fixed by the pilot; run to completion, no peeking.

2026-09-25, AMENDMENT 12a (v2 revision, frozen text kept byte-identical). In the v1 pilot B accepted its first attempt in 50 of 56 runs, so a null would mean verification never ran. v2 adds B-fixed (exactly k = 4 calls, forced verify-and-repair rounds; the recommended primary arm) and B-ext (repair against the benchmark's public examples, never the hidden checks); conditions the estimand on the stratum where the treatment fires; reads the band on the continuous primary measure; and separates pilot and confirmatory pools by task, because hashing by suite name had let 12 of the in-band suite's 34 confirmatory tasks be piloted under another suite name. STATUS: nine of ten piloted suite-tier cells are out of band; the tenth (BigCodeBench-Hard Instruct, Claude Haiku 4.5, 0.648) is in band on its point estimate but its interval crosses 0.70, and it supplies 22 clean in-band confirmatory instances against 93 needed at rho = 0.7. The pilot failed its band criterion; no arm C was run; the confirmatory run was not executed.

2026-09-25, CORRECTION: layer standard errors now cluster by system (sandbox layer G 81.6 +/- 1.8, not +/- 1.2); rates unchanged. 2026-09-28, CORRECTION: the null-fill cap in ablation pooling was lifted, having left self-verification undiscounted; pooled +0.152, discounted +0.076.

2026-09-28, DEVIATION, NO AMENDMENT FILED. The coding-stage codability gate counts a dimension towards the 19 when it is settled (valued or not_reported) and has no layer condition; registered 4.7 counts only values with evidence and needs one in each of layers A, B, C. Amendment 5 moved the test to coding without changing it; the difference was discovered on 2026-09-28, not designed. 613 of 1,256 released systems value fewer than 19 cells; 664 would fail 4.7.

2026-09-28/29, HUMAN CORRECTNESS AUDIT (protocol, seed, sample fixed 2026-09-28; read by the author and colleagues, blind to the model's answers, not to the project). Pooled accuracy 57.7% [48.6, 66.9]; 117 of 148 disagreements are evidence-bundle gaps; 86.7% on cells whose evidence the model received. Silence rates are upper bounds.

RELEASE. HARNESS-DB v1.0.0 (2026-09-25) is public at https://github.com/harness-db/harness-db; Zenodo concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23031354 (v1.0.0: 10.5281/zenodo.23031355). arXiv posting is imminent; the embargo will be ended early.

SOURCES (companion repository): docs/protocol_prisma_p.md (129/105, 27/27, 53, 36, +1.01, +0.88, 613, 664); docs/count_reconciliation.md (6,504, 6,501, 1,234, 984/683/4,837, 1,256, 81.6 +/- 1.8, +0.152/+0.076, 613, 664); docs/tier3_ablation_protocol.md (arms, k = 4, 25-70%, +7, 50 of 56, 12 of 34, 0.648, 22, 93); docs/human_audit_protocol.md with data/audit/results.md and adjudication.json (0.577 [0.486, 0.669], 117 of 148, 202 of 233); CITATION.cff (URL, DOIs).
376-16: 2027-02-12 (planned arXiv preprint and HARNESS-DB v1.0 release). Journal submission planned by 2027-02-26. UPDATE (2026-09-30): the timeline was brought forward; HARNESS-DB v1.0.0 was released on 2026-09-25 (Zenodo concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23031354) and the preprint is posted on arXiv at the time of this update, with journal submission to follow.
376-24: Exploratory review; no confirmatory hypotheses. Expectations recorded for transparency: (E1) tool-interface and context-management dimensions (edit primitive, context compaction) will show more convergence over time than control-loop dimensions; (E2) edit primitive and context compaction will explain more variance in comparable benchmark scores than planning granularity or multi-agent topology; (E3) termination policy, observability and permission model will be the least reported dimensions. Any headline association will be reported as associational with named confounders. UPDATE (amendments 12 and 12a): one confirmatory hypothesis was later added for a controlled ablation, H2: at equal compute, extra model calls spent on verify-and-repair beat the same calls spent on unguided retries. Its pilot failed the pre-stated accuracy band and no confirmatory run was made, so the review remains exploratory in its reported results.
376-14: 2026-09-16 (protocol work began). Search execution planned to start 2026-10-05. UPDATE: the search was brought forward, executed and frozen on 2026-09-16 after registration, before any screening.
